notes.title: Update V1.1.6
notes.content:
Optimized several locations where FPS drops were previously observed.

Simplified the "Vet Clinic" location.

Minor fixes and improvements for better stability and overall gameplay experience.

notes.title: Update V1.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]🛠️ Fixes:[/b][/h3]

[b]Fixed phone call logic[/b]  
[i]Previously, making or receiving calls would cause errors, preventing the phone system from working properly. The phone call system is now stable.[/i]

[b]Fixed issue with getting stuck in the wardrobe in the doctor's room[/b]  
[i]Previously, entering the built-in wardrobe would trap the player with no way to escape.[/i]

[b]Improved doctor (NPC) behavior[/b]  
[i]NPC doctor's movement paths and reactions have been adjusted.[/i]

[b]Mini-game panel no longer disappears when interacting with the lever in the cages area[/b]  
[i]Previously, activating the lever could cause the mini-game panel to disappear.[/i]

[b]Fixed incorrect behavior when moving objects beyond their allowed zone[/b]  
[i]Previously, if jumping outside the movable object's zone, it would remain in a "moving" state, causing visual and logical errors.[/i]

[b]Fixed issues when grabbing objects through wardrobes[/b]  
[i]Resolved situations where trying to grab an item behind a wardrobe would cause freezing or malfunctioning wardrobes. Now wardrobe interactions are predictable, and objects can only be grabbed from accessible areas.[/i]



[h3][b]👾 Balance and Gameplay:[/b][/h3]

[b]Increased monster spawn intervals[/b]  
[i]Enemy spawn intervals have been adjusted — monsters now appear less frequently, giving players more time to explore before encounters.[/i]



[h3][b]🚀 Optimization and Performance:[/b][/h3]

[b]Added VSync support[/b]  
[i]Eliminates screen tearing.[/i]

[b]FPS capped at 360 FPS[/b]  
[i]Reduces unnecessary GPU load on high-refresh rate monitors.[/i]

[b]Optimized internal rendering and data loading processes[/b]  
[i]Reduced CPU and GPU load, especially on high-end systems.[/i]



[h3][b]✨ Other minor fixes and improvements:[/b][/h3]

[i]It now takes more than twice as little time to cut through the grates: instead of the previous 40–80 “screams” per grate, the number has been reduced to 10–25. As a result, the total time to complete this stage has been reduced from approximately 5 minutes to about 1 minute.[/i]

[i]The monster’s movement speed in the "Vet Clinic" location has been increased: previously it moved at regular walking speed, now it is significantly faster.[/i]

[i]Overall game volume has been increased.[/i]

[i]Minor graphical artifact fixes in several locations.[/i]

[i]Cleaned up erroneous logs and warnings in the console.[/i]

[i]Improved sound system stability.[/i]

[i]The movable object "Stone" no longer bounces :( .[/i]

And other small improvements.

[h2][b]🎮 Enjoy the game![/b][/h2]
